name: Kharkiv Municipal Gallery
known: Programmes: the NonStopMedia youth projects festival since 2003, a curatorial intensive first held in 2015, Night of Museums in Kharkiv, Night of Performance since 2016, the retrospective series "Our Heritage" and residency exchanges since 2011 (Ukrainian Wikipedia).
Wikipedia lists Tetiana Tumasian as director and curator.

According to the report, the city council and Mayor Ihor Terekhov had agreed remotely with the director that the city's communal news programme "Харків: новини" would use the premises at Chernyshevska 15 temporarily, and staff were told they would move to a children's art school at Yesenina Street 8

After public backlash, Terekhov phoned the director on 11 March and, according to the gallery, said the premises would remain gallery space, that the city guarantees its return, and that the collection, archive and library would stay in the sealed storage on site.
It names only co-founder and director Tatyana Tumasyan.
